session.note: No live session right now. The connection rehearsal passed all three fault drills (crash, low disk, late start). The next session is on hold: the relay machine stopped answering at about 03:16.

groups.title: Base scenes
groups.blurb: 5 original scenes and 7 new rooms. Each shows its latest snapshot; with a live session it opens in Isaac Sim to play, pause, reset, move the camera and inspect instruments.

items.title: Intelligent chemistry robot platform
items.line: Passes the strict 600-step stability test
items.details: A three-neck flask that tipped at step 7 is fixed. Full sweep: 0 blockers.

items.title: Organic synthesis lab
items.line: Passes the strict 600-step stability test
items.details: A pestle that tipped at step 5 is fixed. Full sweep: 0 blockers.

items.title: Analysis centre + weighing unit
items.line: Passes the strict 600-step stability test
items.details: Holds the pilot balance station. A 50 ml beaker standing on a 0.4 mm contact point got a 1 mm flat foot; the dispenser, oven and titrator repairs hold.

items.title: Electrochemistry & energy materials lab
items.line: Passes the strict 600-step stability test
items.details: A free-standing vessel that tipped at step 1 is fixed. Full sweep: 0 blockers.

items.title: FR3 100 mL weighing & recovery unit
items.line: Passes the strict 600-step stability test
items.details: Two sample objects had been placed 7 mm above their support; with a 1 mm gap the room passes.

items.title: Double-island wet-chemistry hall
items.line: 87 unstable parts; cause analysis done, fixes prepared
items.details: By evidence: 42 are cable links held by constrained joints, 40 have a position drive but still move (2 of them, a micropipette button and dial, have a drive target that differs from the starting pose), 5 lack a restoring drive. Nearly all root parts start with overlapping collision shapes; fixes are prepared for the next run.

items.title: U-shaped bio / electrochemistry cell
items.line: 98 unstable parts; likely cause found for the main instrument
items.details: About 40 root causes sit behind the moving parts in the new rooms. On the WTW OxiTop here, each of the six sensor heads starts with its collision shape 24.000 mm inside its sleeve, and each head jumps 24.0001 mm on the first step, a match to five digits. A collision-shape fix for one head and a latch are both prepared, with an untouched control, for the next run. Not yet confirmed in the simulator.

items.title: Continuous-flow corridor
items.line: 12 unstable parts; one cause matched to a starting overlap
items.details: A desorber lid starts 25.422 mm inside a neighbouring tube and jumps 25.422 mm on start-up. 6 other parts are robot gripper parts whose source model is not available locally.

items.title: L-shaped digestion / separation suite
items.line: 23 unstable parts; cause analysis done
items.details: 21 have a position drive but still move, 1 has a non-zero speed target, 1 lacks a restoring drive. Two valves turn to their 180° stop on the first step; a latch test with a control is prepared.

items.title: Six-bay analysis centre
items.line: Simulator still crashes at step 1
items.details: Two groups of 13 and 14 instruments each crash at step 1; 7 narrowing cases are prepared.

items.title: Ring logistics hall
items.line: Crashes at step 1 because of one instrument
items.details: Runs all 660 steps without the particle-size analyser. That instrument crashes as a whole but each half runs, so no single part is isolated yet; 7 narrowing cases are prepared.

items.title: Inert multi-room suite
items.line: 22 unstable parts; cause analysis done
items.details: 14 have a position drive but still move, 6 are robot gripper parts whose source model is not available locally, 2 lack a restoring drive. The two glovebox doors swing to their 90° stop on the first step; a latch test with a control is prepared.

groups.title: Auto-built scenes
groups.blurb: Scenes generated automatically from papers and protocols: one command goes from paper to protocol to scene, and the robot is placed automatically. Five are packaged for the live viewer.

items.title: Balance routine check (NIST IR 6969)
items.line: Stability test passed; used for the 100 g pilot
items.details: Robot bench, robot, balance and reference weights, empty pan with pan lock. Passes the shared support rules (54 checks, 0 fail) and the 600-step stability test. The 100 g pilot package passes its 109 checks.

items.title: Moisture by loss on drying
items.line: Passed source review; simulator checks waiting
items.details: Second pilot. One robot station reaches every pick and place point (0.61 rad joint margin). Sample-pan fixture built from the manual (90 mm pan).

items.title: Titration
items.line: Collision shapes added from the source meshes; re-export next
items.details: The titrator's stir bar and piston had no collision shape in the source model. A repair layer now adds one from each part's own visible mesh (convex hull), with nothing invented. The scene is being re-exported and still needs the simulator checks.

items.title: HPLC
items.line: Passed source review; simulator checks waiting
items.details: Real instruments, robot and bench. Passes the support check (258 pass, 11 warnings). Waits for the 600-step stability run.

items.title: liang2021
items.line: Layout fits 2 robot stations; not run natively

items.title: meloxicam2022
items.line: Passed source review; simulator checks waiting
items.details: Real instruments, robot and bench. Passes the support check (360 pass, 12 warnings). Waits for the 600-step stability run.

items.title: 13 more source papers
items.line: 19 papers in the pipeline; none passes full operation yet
items.details: Every layout is checked against each instrument's real physics data (moving parts, collision shapes, joints). The pipeline now refuses to overwrite an earlier scene when its inputs change. About 300 native checks are still open.

groups.title: Lab execution
groups.blurb: The robot doing real tasks in the simulator. Five skills are approved, pick-and-place included; the first full experiment is next.

items.title: Move to pose · planned joint path
items.line: Both approved after independent re-checks
items.details: Move to pose: 16 of 16 trials. Planned joint path: 12 of 12 across 3 independent runs, worst 0.93 mm / 0.10°, refusals correct. Scope: the isolated robot cell.

items.title: Balance reading · wait for stable
items.line: Stable readings; approved for 100 g and 500 g
items.details: First stable reading: the 100 g weight read 99.99995 g, settled within 0.01 g one second after release. Approved for 100 g and 500 g in the calibration fixture with a 0.2 s display filter. 1 kg and 2 kg are still on hold.

items.title: Pick and place a 100 g weight
items.line: Approved: 5 complete passes, independently re-checked
items.details: Approved for the isolated robot cell with the 100 g reference weight (50 N grip, smooth 1 s lift start). Five complete pick-lift-hold-place-release runs across two jobs: placement error 0.35–0.40 mm (limit 5 mm), slip while held 0.04–0.08 mm (limit 2 mm). The independent check compared 35,352 recorded values and 4.1 million contact pairs, with full agreement and zero violations. Two further attempts were cut off by a real-time limit and are counted as not observed. Not yet approved for the balance station.

items.title: Plan-driven motion over the balance pan
items.line: Refused by a safety check; fix ready for the next run
items.details: A balance button shifted slightly after the route was checked, so the run was refused. Moving parts may now shift up to 0.5 mm before a re-check; fixed parts must still match exactly.

items.title: Experiment 12: 100 g balance routine check
items.line: Formal run request ready (37 calls); waits for the trial job
items.details: Chosen as the first full native experiment. The formal request is compiled: 3 automated pre-checks, 25 robot and instrument calls and 9 calculation steps, with 307 evidence items to record. In the balance scene the 25 physical calls run with a diagnostic label until the skills are approved there, so a complete run does not yet count as an experiment pass. The trial job is ready to submit once the relay machine is reachable again.

items.title: Experiment 13: moisture test
items.line: Plan compiled (6 steps); waits for sample-pan and lid skills

items.title: Main lab (pilot station in place)
items.line: Room is stable; no robot run here yet
items.details: The main lab passed the 600-step stability test on 11-07. Robot work moves here after the fixture runs pass.

timeline.text: New rooms: 40 of the 41 root parts start with overlapping collision shapes; for 7 the overlap depth matches the start-up jump to five digits.
New rooms: most moving parts just follow a moving parent; about 40 root causes remain to be confirmed in the next run.
New rooms: drive strength and targets ruled out as the cause for 177 of 179 moving parts; titrator collision shapes repaired from its own meshes.
New rooms: all 242 unstable parts classified by evidence (74% have a position drive but still move); 19 test cases prepared for the next run.
Formal request for the 100 g balance run is ready: 37 calls, rehearsed end to end with a simulated robot.
Four of the five auto-built scenes pass the base-scene review; titration goes back for two missing collision shapes.
Live-window connection rehearsal passes all three fault drills; the session itself is on hold because the relay machine stopped answering.
Five auto-built scenes packaged for the live viewer (balance, moisture, titration, HPLC, meloxicam); stability runs queued.
Pick-and-place approved for the isolated robot cell after an independent re-check of both runs.

The 100 g balance routine check is chosen as the first full native experiment.
First complete pick-and-place: 3 of 4 attempts pick, lift, hold, place and release the 100 g weight.
All 5 original base scenes pass the strict 600-step stability test.
Balance reading approved (100 g and 500 g).
Planned joint path approved as the second robot skill.
Move to pose approved as the first robot skill.
First stable balance reading: 100 g reads 99.99995 g.
Live debug session: all 15 scenes opened and captured.
Paper → protocol → scene runs as one command, with automatic robot placement.
